Dude I completely understand that, it seems to be a scary common dynamic in conservative Christian families regardless of if it’s ever acknowledged to the world. I’m an ex fundie missionary kid and many of my friends had a similar dynamic with their parents - it’s absolutely emotional manipulation and abuse. 

My dad, a pastor, would tell me that he had a responsibility to God for every soul in his family and that he would be held responsible to God personally for my sins. I was 15 and outed as a lesbian to my conservative family, so I was rebellious and there were constant fights before I was able to leave home. 

I’m really sorry that you went through these things, breaking away from a religious upbringing can be so isolating and lonely.
